name: SEO Landing Page
description: Keyword brief → structure → implement page → technical SEO → browser QA.
kickoff:
Start the "SEO Landing Page" loop.
Goal: landing page live-ready for target keyword
Max iterations: 6
Exit when: technical SEO and browser QA pass.
Orientation: read the linked ticket for target keyword, audience, and page goal.
Step 1: Confirm keyword brief and page structure plan.

loop_contract.name: SEO Landing Page
loop_contract.goal: landing page meets keyword brief and technical SEO bar
loop_contract.exit_when: technical SEO and browser QA pass
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
loop_contract.step_1: Extract target keyword, intent, audience, and conversion goal from the ticket.
